name: FDE Mags
teaser: Retextured mags that did not have FDE variant.
description_html:
Description

Some of the bigger magazines didn’t have the FDE version, so some good builds didn’t look as good.

Big thanks to YankeeNoodle742 for the D.U.D.S round, on which I based my project.

List of FDE mags:

AK 7.62x39 X Products X-47 50-round drum magazine

AK-74 5.45x39 6L23 30-round magazine

AK-74 5.45x39 6L26 45-round magazine

AK-74 5.45x39 6L31 60-round magazine

RPK-16 5.45x39 95-round drum magazine

SKS 7.62x39 ProMag AALVX 35-round magazine

SKS 7.62x39 ProMag SKS-A5 20-round magazine

5.56x45 Magpul PMAG D-60 STANAG 60-round magazine

DVL-10 7.62x51 10-round magazine

Mk-18 .338 LM 10-round magazine

SA-58/FAL 7.62x51 X Products X-FAL 50-round drum magazine

FN Five-seveN 5.7x28 20-round magazine

RSh-12 12.7x55 5-round cylinder

Known bugs

1. RSh-12 12.7x55 5-round cylinder does not have an icon when it is empty.
2. Some mags are bypassing conflicts
